map.CSV 用逗号分隔、引号包裹含逗号的字段。列数不一致或引号未闭合会导致导入失败。: CSV is comma-separated, and fields containing a comma are wrapped in quotes. Inconsistent column counts or unbalanced quotes make an import fail. This tool parses line by line and reports the offending row numbers so you can clean the data.
map.校验 CSV 文件的格式合法性。: Validates the well-formedness of a CSV file.
map.：列数是否一致、引号是否闭合、分隔符是否统一、编码（UTF-8/BOM）与必填列: : whether column counts are consistent, quotes are balanced, the delimiter is uniform, the encoding is sound (UTF-8 / BOM), and required columns are present.
map.：字段含分隔符、双引号或换行时必须用双引号包裹，内部双引号写成两个。: : a field containing the delimiter, a double quote or a newline must be wrapped in double quotes, with inner quotes written as two.
map.：Excel 导出的 BOM 头、中英文逗号混用、行尾多余分隔符、CRLF 与: : the BOM that Excel writes, a mix of full-width and ASCII commas, a stray trailing delimiter, and mixed CRLF and LF line endings.
map.：逐行给出错误位置与原因，便于定位修复。: : reports the position and cause of each error line by line, making fixes easy to locate.
map.粘贴 CSV（首行为表头）: Paste CSV (first row is the header)
map.RFC 4180 规定：每行字段数应一致，字段内含逗号/换行时用双引号包裹，引号: RFC 4180 requires every row to have the same number of fields, any field containing a comma or newline to be wrapped in double quotes, and a literal quote inside a quoted field to be written as two double quotes.
map.本工具以首行列数为基准比对；若表头本身列数异常，后续全部行会判为不一致，请先确认: This tool compares against the column count of the first row; if the header itself is malformed, every following row is flagged as inconsistent, so verify the header first.
map.分号、制表符分隔的「CSV」可改分隔符参数（欧洲常用分号）。: Semicolon- and tab-separated "CSV" files can be handled by changing the delimiter option (semicolons are common in Europe).
map.检查列数一致、引号闭合。: Check that column counts match and quotes are balanced.
map.导入前先校验：确认每行列数一致、引号闭合、编码正确，避免坏数据进库后再逐条排查。: Validate before importing: confirm every row has the same column count, quotes are balanced and the encoding is correct, so bad data does not reach the database and force row-by-row debugging.
map.某行 3 列其余 2 列 → 报错：列数不一致。: One row with 3 columns against 2 elsewhere → error: inconsistent column count.
map.引号内逗号算分隔吗？: Does a comma inside quotes count as a delimiter?
map.不算，引号字段内的逗号是字段内容。: No — a comma inside a quoted field is part of the field content.
map.为什么提示列数不一致？: Why is it reporting an inconsistent column count?
map.多数情况是引号未闭合或: Most often it is an unbalanced quote or
map.不统一：某行有一个未配对的双引号，会让解析器把后续多行吞成一个字段；此外文件混用: being inconsistent: a single unpaired double quote on a row makes the parser swallow several following rows into one field. Mixed CRLF and LF line endings, or a missing final newline, can trigger it too. Check the quote pairing on the reported row and the row before it.
